macro.headline: July PPI + weekly initial jobless claims hit the 08:30 ET tape together, one day after the in-line CPI. PPI printed SLIGHTLY BELOW expectations (consensus +0.2% m/m), extending the disinflation read; claims consensus was 202K. Two soft inflation prints back-to-back takes the September rate-hike scare further off the table.
macro.fed: Fed speeches scheduled today per the economic calendar, but NO voting members on the docket -- low headline risk from Fed commentary. The 30-year auction at 13:00 ET closes out this week's refunding and is the one bond-market event that could move duration-sensitive equities.
macro.geopolitical: Iran/Middle East oil overhang unchanged and still off the front page. No new geopolitical driver this morning.
macro.tape_today: QUIETER and MORE MIXED than yesterday's AI-infra melt-up -- this is the key difference. Index futures only mildly higher into the open (S&P +0.2%, Nasdaq-100 ~flat, Dow +0.3%), but the single-name tech tape has visibly turned two-way on EARNINGS: CSCO -7% pre (results disappointed), Cerebras -15% pre, COHR -6% pre (momentum top-decile name #18 in our own report). That is the opposite of yesterday, when CRWV +18% / NBIS +12.5% / SMCI +9% swept the AI-infra complex higher. Pre-market ~13:01Z: SPY 774.44 (+0.25%), QQQ 724.68 (+0.14%), NVDA 224.21 (+0.05%), AMD 482.30 (-0.13%), TSM 429.01 (-0.03%), AVGO 416.00 (flat), MSFT 496.00 (+0.73%), TSLA 325.42 (-0.64%), INTC 101.21 (+0.26%).
